titulo: The remote and the TV next door

frases.texto: Your TV remote was almost going to change the channel next door.
Radio goes through the wall, so one press would flip both TVs.
So they built a click the wall could stop.
A tiny hammer hit a metal rod, about as long as your thumb.
Four notes, too high to hear: next channel, last channel, mute, and off.
No batteries. If they died, you'd think the TV was broken.
Nine million TVs listened to that click for twenty five years.
Then the click became a light you can't see, and you have to point it.
Your phone is radio again, but only for the TV in your house.
The app is in the link in bio.
Send it to that friend who keeps losing the remote.
